temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual during their shifts. When Jose asks if something is wrong, she says it is personal stuff, thanks him, and appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is usually vibrant at work, and Jose does not know of any serious problem troubling her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her withdrawn demeanor and vague response suggest she is dealing with a personal issue but is not ready to share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia likely has a personal problem she is keeping private, and she appreciates Jose's supportive offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.intention: stay available as a supportive listener without pressuring Patricia to talk

temporal_state_chain.observed: During lunch, Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. In conversation, she confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and says his offer to discuss financial planning could be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia seems to have a personal issue she is private about, but Jose does not know it is financial; he believes she appreciates his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He learns that financial stress is a concrete concern for Patricia and that she is receptive to his help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is stressed about bills and finances and is open to discussing budgeting or financial planning with him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: offer to review budgeting and financial planning together when Patricia feels ready

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks whether he overstepped by bringing up financial planning. Patricia says he was not prying, that she is grateful, and that it is good to have someone to turn to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is financially stressed and open to his help, but Jose worries that his offer may have crossed a boundary.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Patricia's reassurance resolves his worry and confirms that his offer was welcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his support and does not see his concern as prying; Jose can remain a supportive friend while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: continue supporting Patricia as a friend while being mindful of her boundaries

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose senses Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately. In a casual check-in, she says everything is all good and she plans a quiet weekend; Jose offers to be available, and she thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia values his support and has not accused him of overstepping, and Jose still wants to be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He infers that Patricia appreciates his concern but wants to manage her issues privately and may not want active help right now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers privacy; Jose should remain available without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.intention: maintain low-pressure supportive contact and offer help only if Patricia asks

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose continues regular supportive check-ins at work. Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support. Jose replies that he is there anytime and that coworkers help each other.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately; she is likely managing on her own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change. Her response reinforces that she is handling things and values his supportive presence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is busy but managing; Jose's low-pressure support is welcome, and she knows she can reach out to him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: continue being available and checking in supportively, offering small practical help without intruding
